div.div:
The invariant
Plane 5 is asynchronous and optional. A provider outage, throttling, graph unavailability or budget exhaustion must never block Planes 1 to 3, or add an availability dependency to them.
The 50k events/sec target belongs to deterministic streaming and is never a claim about LLM throughput.
